config.rationale: Fast CNN baseline to establish the lower-bound accuracy and validate the training pipeline. 4 conv blocks with 64 base channels, global average pooling, and 0.2 dropout on the classification head. Standardize normalization preserves the green channel's higher variance (std 0.177 vs 0.124). Class-weighted CE addresses the 1.63x imbalance. LR=1e-3 with cosine decay is standard for small CNNs with AdamW. hflip + brightness augmentation provides spatial and photometric regularization without risking domain shift from rotation. This candidate is the fastest to train and gives a clean reference point for the transformer candidates.
